rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated HC data from two datasets (CamCAN and UCLA phenomics).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The data utilised is from two existing datasets: CamCAN ageing and UCLA phenomics"

rci2_using_epd.detail: CamCAN (public repository) used for HC normative modeling; UCLA phenomics also included.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "the healthy ageing CamCAN dataset (obtained from the CamCAN repository available at http://www.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/datasets/CamCAN/)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: CamCAN healthy ageing dataset used in the HC reference cohort.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "the healthy ageing CamCAN dataset (obtained from the CamCAN repository available at http://www.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/datasets/CamCAN/)"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC; computed from train/test split (CamCAN 346 + UCLA 78).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "resulting in CamCAN = 346/150 and UCLA = 78/33 train/test subdivisions"

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase sex breakdown not reported; only overall HC sex counts reported.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "Following quality control exclusions, imaging data of a total of 607 healthy subjects (CamCAN: N =496, Mean age (SD) = 52.3 (18.3), M/F = 255/241; UCLA: N =111, Mean age (SD) = 31.2 (8.7), M/F = 60/51) were included in the analysis."

rci7_age.detail: Training phase age statistics not reported; only overall HC ages by dataset reported.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Following quality control exclusions, imaging data of a total of 607 healthy subjects (CamCAN: N =496, Mean age (SD) = 52.3 (18.3), M/F = 255/241; UCLA: N =111, Mean age (SD) = 31.2 (8.7), M/F = 60/51) were included in the analysis."
